title: fair-ca-visualization: interactive visualization of the FAIR COMBINE Archive Indicators

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
fair-ca-visualization is a Streamlit app and python package for the interactive visualization of assessments of computational models with the FAIR COMBINE Archive Indicators (FAIR-CA). The app is available from https://faircombine.streamlit.app, the package from PyPI, the source code from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/fair-ca-visualization and the documentation from https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/fair-ca-visualization.

If you have any questions or issues please open an issue.
